title: LessLeak-Bench: A First Investigation of Data Leakage in LLMs Across 83 Software Engineering Benchmarks
authors_zh: Xin Zhou, Martin Weyssow, Ratnadira Widyasari, Ting Zhang, Junda He, Yunbo Lyu, Jianming Chang, Beiqi Zhang, Dan Huang, David Lo
paper_type_zh: 基准污染与数据泄漏审计研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计代码基准污染和评测偏差的研究者。
one_line: Measures and removes verified pre-training leakage across 83 software-engineering benchmarks.
测量并删除 83 个软件工程基准中经核验的预训练泄漏样本。
why: It gives concrete evidence that benchmark contamination can inflate LLM evaluation and a release to mitigate it.
inclusion_reason: Audits benchmark contamination and supplies manually verified leakage records plus cleaned evaluation data.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Software-engineering benchmarks may occur in an LLM's pre-training corpus, inflating evaluation scores; most models do not disclose enough training data for a direct audit. The field lacked a broad, manually checked measurement across languages and benchmark sources.

LessLeak-Bench studies 83 Java, Python, and C/C++ benchmarks against StarCoder pre-training data, labels suspected duplicates, and releases cleaned benchmark records plus a leakage-detection dataset.

软件工程基准可能已进入大语言模型预训练语料，进而抬高评测分数；多数模型又不公开足够训练数据，难以直接审计。该领域此前缺少跨语言、经人工核验的大规模泄漏测量。

LessLeak-Bench 将 83 个 Java、Python、C/C++ 基准同 StarCoder 预训练语料比较，标注疑似重复对，并发布清理后的基准记录和泄漏检测数据。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper turns leakage auditing into candidate generation plus human verification: MinHash+LSH finds near-duplicate benchmark/pre-training pairs, annotators label them, and leakage ratios determine which items are removed. The official Hugging Face release contains 6,691 verified pairs with identifiers, both contents, dataset name, language, similarity label, and binary leakage label. It is an evaluation and audit dataset; original-source licenses still apply.
论文把泄漏审计变成“候选生成加人工核验”：MinHash+LSH 找到基准与预训练语料的近重复对，标注者判定后以泄漏率决定删除哪些样本。官方 Hugging Face 发布含 6,691 个核验对，字段包括标识、双方内容、基准名、语言、相似度标签与二元泄漏标签。它是评测和审计数据；原始来源许可仍适用。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Collect 83 SE benchmarks and the disclosed StarCoder pre-training corpus across Java, Python, and C/C++.
  1. Run MinHash+LSH over benchmark/pre-training pairs to nominate near duplicates; the scale is 1.7 trillion compared pairs.
  1. Eight experienced annotators review nominated pairs and assign duplicate labels; confirmed duplicates determine each benchmark's leakage ratio.
  1. Remove confirmed leaked items to form LessLeak-Bench, and retain 6,691 manually verified pairs for detection research. Reproduction requires the exact corpus, benchmark revisions, MinHash parameters, annotation policy, and original licenses; detection without disclosed pre-training data is not solved.

1. 汇集 83 个软件工程基准和公开的 StarCoder 预训练语料，覆盖 Java、Python、C/C++。
  1. 对基准与预训练样本运行 MinHash+LSH，产生近重复候选对；比较规模为 1.7 万亿对。
  1. 八名有经验的标注者复核候选对并给出重复标签；确认重复后计算每个基准的泄漏率。
  1. 删除确认泄漏样本形成 LessLeak-Bench，同时保留 6,691 个经人工核验的样本对供检测研究。复现须固定语料、基准版本、MinHash 参数和标注规则，并遵守原始许可；预训练数据不公开时的检测问题尚未解决。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Across 83 benchmarks, average leakage is 4.8% for Python, 2.8% for Java, and 0.7% for C/C++; the distribution is uneven, with QuixBugs at 100% and BigCloneBench at 55.7%. On APPS, StarCoder-7B Pass@1 is 4.9 times higher on leaked than non-leaked samples. These findings support a real evaluation threat for the disclosed corpus, not a claim about every model or hidden pre-training set.
在 83 个基准中，Python、Java、C/C++ 的平均泄漏率分别为 4.8%、2.8%、0.7%，但分布很不均匀：QuixBugs 为 100%，BigCloneBench 为 55.7%。在 APPS 上，StarCoder-7B 的泄漏样本 Pass@1 是非泄漏样本的 4.9 倍。证据支持公开语料下存在真实评测威胁，不能推断所有模型或隐藏预训练集都有同样情况。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior leakage studies and duplicate detectors seldom combine a disclosed pre-training corpus, broad SE coverage, human confirmation, and cleaned releases. This work moves from measuring overlap to publishing removal-ready benchmark records and labeled detection pairs. MinHash is not new; the contribution is the audited benchmark-scale application and the decision boundary it exposes. Reuse requires checking the target model's corpus and benchmark revision.
既有泄漏研究和重复检测器很少同时具备公开预训练语料、广泛的软件工程覆盖、人工确认和清理后发布。本文把工作从测量重合推进到发布可删除的基准记录与带标签检测对。MinHash 并不新；贡献是经审计的基准级应用及其揭示的决策边界。复用须核对目标模型语料和基准版本。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The audit is anchored to StarCoder's disclosed corpus, so it cannot establish leakage rates for closed or different models. MinHash+LSH produces candidates rather than proof, and manual labels depend on policy and source versions. Before using the cleaned set, verify the target benchmark release and whether the target model's training lineage is comparable.
该审计以公开的 StarCoder 语料为锚，不能给出闭源或其他模型的泄漏率。MinHash+LSH 只产生候选而非证明，人工标签也依赖标注规则与来源版本。使用清理数据前，应核对目标基准版本，并检查目标模型的训练来源是否具有可比性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For an SE benchmark evaluation, map the benchmark version to the release, filter its flagged records, and report both original and cleaned results. Use the 6,691 labeled pairs to test a new leakage detector by language and benchmark. Do not claim a model is clean when its pre-training corpus is unavailable; report the audit coverage boundary instead.
评估软件工程基准时，可先把基准版本映射到该发布，过滤已标记记录，并同时报告原始和清理后的结果。可用 6,691 个带标签样本对按语言和基准测试新的泄漏检测器。预训练语料不可得时，不能宣称模型无泄漏，只能报告审计覆盖边界。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Position: audits pre-training leakage in 83 SE benchmarks and releases cleaned records.
  • Lever: MinHash+LSH proposes pairs; eight annotators decide the leakage label.
  • Artifact: 6,691 verified pairs expose contents, language, source benchmark, similarity, and binary label.
  • Evidence: average leakage is low but QuixBugs reaches 100%; leaked APPS samples yield 4.9x StarCoder-7B Pass@1.
  • Reuse: filter exact release records and state the corpus-coverage limit before comparing models.

• 定位：审计 83 个软件工程基准的预训练泄漏，并发布清理记录。
  • 抓手：MinHash+LSH 产生候选对，八名标注者决定泄漏标签。
  • 材料：6,691 个核验对公开双方内容、语言、来源基准、相似度和二元标签。
  • 证据：平均泄漏率不高，但 QuixBugs 达 100%；泄漏 APPS 样本的 StarCoder-7B Pass@1 高 4.9 倍。
  • 复用：按确切发布版本过滤记录，并在模型比较前说明语料覆盖边界。
